name: Druid Lunar-Touched Druid
body:
The moon’s influence on a lunar-touched druid’s magic manifests itself as power over darkness, gravity, and the tides.

A lunar-touched druid has the following class features.

Class Skills

A lunar-touched druid adds Stealth to her list of class skills, and removes Ride.

This alters class skills.

Moon Magic (Ex)

As the moon’s phases are constantly changing, so too do a lunar-touched druid’s prepared spells. She has one fewer spell slot of each level than a regular druid. If this reduces her number of spell slots of a particular level to zero, she can cast spells of that level only if her Wisdom allows bonus spells of that level.

A number of times per day equal to her Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), a lunar-touched druid can “lose” a prepared spell in order to spontaneously cast any other spell on the druid spell list of the same level or lower. At 5th level, and every five levels thereafter, a lunar-touched druid can spontaneously cast one additional spell in this manner.

This alters the druid’s spells per day and spontaneous casting.

Lunar Legacy (Ex)

At 1st level, a lunar-touched druid’s lunar legacy can take one of two forms.

The first is a close tie to night, the time at which the moon can be seen most prominently. A lunar-touched druid selecting this option gains the powers of the darkness domain and additional domain spell slots, just like a cleric.

Her bonus domain spells, however, are not taken from the darkness domain spell list. Instead, a lunar-touched druid gains the following list of domain spells: 1st—air bubble; 2nd—stone call; 3rd—deep slumber; 4th—air walk; 5th—tidal surge; 6th—cloak of dreams; 7th—lunar veil; 8th—reverse gravity; 9th—tsunami.

The second is to form a close bond with a nocturnal animal companion. This ability functions exactly as a druid’s animal companion except that the creature chosen must be nocturnal (badger/dire, bat/dire, beaver, coyote, crocodile, feline [all], fox, frog/giant, hedgehog, hyena, kangaroo, owl, raccoon, rat/dire, scorpion/giant, skunk/giant, weasel/giant, wolf/dire).

Once the lunar-touched druid has selected what form their lunar legacy takes, it cannot be changed.

This alters nature bond.

Nocturnal Senses (Ex)

At 1st level, a lunar-touched druid gains low-light vision and a +2 bonus on Perception and Stealth skill checks. At 4th level, a lunar-touched druid gains darkvision 60 feet. (If she already has darkvision, it increases by 30 feet.)

This replaces wild empathy, nature sense, and resist nature’s lure.

Lunar Stride (Ex)

A lunar-touched druid can alter gravity. At 2nd level, she gains a +2 bonus on Acrobatics skill checks, and is always considered to have a running start when making Acrobatics checks to jump. Additionally, a lunar-touched druid treats her Strength score as 4 higher when determining her carrying capacity.

At 9th level, the druid’s Acrobatics checks to jump are no longer modified by the surface on which she stands.

At 15th level, a lunar-touched druid’s bonus on Acrobatics skill checks increases to +4, and she is considered to be constantly under the effects of feather fall.

This replaces woodland stride, and timeless body.

Eclipse (Ex)

At 3rd level, once per day, as a swift action, a lunar-touched druid can increase or decrease the light levels within 100 feet by 1 step (bright to normal, normal to dim, dim to dark) for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 her druid level. These effects stack, and each level lower costs another round of eclipse to use.

This replaces trackless step.

Lunar Aura (Su)

A lunar-touched druid can generate auras with opposing effects just as the moon experiences extremes in light and temperature.

At 4th level, a lunar-touched druid gains the ability to assume a lunar aura of their choice once per day. The effect lasts for 1 hour per lunar-touched druid level or until she selects another aura. Generating an aura is a standard action which does not provoke an attack of opportunity. A lunar-touched druid can have only one aura active at a time.

Any time an aura ability requires a saving throw, the DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 the lunar-touched druid’s level + her Wisdom modifier. A lunar-touched druid can use this ability an additional time per day at 6th level and every four levels thereafter, for a total of five times per day at 18th level. The lunar auras are as follows: Aura of Clarity and Confusion: While under the influence of this aura, a lunar-touched druid gains a +2 insight bonus to attack rolls, caster level checks, concentration checks, and Will saves. This bonus increases by +1 at 6th and 10th level.

Additionally, when a lunar-touched druid rolls a natural 20 on a melee attack roll against a target while this aura is active, the target must make a successful Will save or suffer the dazed condition for 1 round. At 16th level, a creature failing its Will save gains the confused condition for a number of rounds equal to the lunar-touched druid’s Wisdom modifier instead. When a creature rolls a natural 1 on its melee attack roll against the lunar-touched druid while this aura is in effect, the creature becomes distracted, losing its Dexterity bonus to AC and gaining the flat-footed condition until the start of its next turn. (There is no save for this effect.)

At 12th level, all enemies beginning their turn within 5 feet of a lunar-touched druid under the influence of this aura must make a successful Will save or become hesitant, suffering a -2 circumstance penalty on attack rolls while within the aura and for 1 round after leaving it. A creature that successfully saves against this effect is immune to the same druid’s aura for 24 hours. The effects requiring Will saves from this ability are mind-affecting effects.

Aura of Frost and Flame: When assuming this aura, a lunar-touched druid must decide whether it will be a frost or flame aura. The frost or flame component does not change for the duration of the aura. While under the influence of this aura, a lunar-touched druid gains the benefits of endure elements, and inflicts 3 additional points of either cold (frost) or fire (flame) damage on successful melee attacks.

This bonus damage automatically bypasses any energy resistance the target might have. It increases by 3 at 6th and 10th level.

Additionally, when a lunar-touched druid rolls a natural 20 on a melee attack roll against a target while this aura is active, the target must make a successful Fortitude save or suffer the fatigued condition as though suffering from hypothermia (frost) or heatstroke (flame) for 1 round. At 16th level, the fatigued condition lasts for a number of rounds equal to the lunar-touched druid’s Wisdom modifier instead.

Unlike the normal fatigued condition, the fatigue caused by this aura disappears after the duration of the ability’s effect expires.

At 12th level, a lunar-touched druid under the influence of this aura is considered to be constantly under the effects of fire shield, with the caveat that a creature striking the lunartouched druid with its body or handheld weapon only suffers 1d6 points of fire or cold damage.

Aura of Liveliness and Lethargy: While under the influence of this aura, a lunar-touched druid gains a +5 foot bonus (untyped) to her land speed, a +2 dodge bonus to AC, a +2 morale bonus on Initiative rolls, and a +2 resistance bonus on Reflex saves. The bonus to speed increases by +5 feet and all other bonuses increase by +1 at 6th, 10th, and 12th level.

Additionally, when a lunar-touched druid rolls a natural 20 on a melee attack roll against a target while this aura is in effect, the target must make a successful Fortitude save or suffer the staggered condition for 1 round. At 16th level, the staggered condition lasts for a number of rounds equal to the lunar-touched druid’s Wisdom modifier instead. When a creature rolls a natural 1 on its melee attack roll against the lunar-touched druid while this aura is in effect, it becomes sluggish until the start of its next turn, incurring a -2 penalty on Reflex saving throws and a -10 foot penalty to its speed.

This ability cannot cause a creature’s speed to drop below 5 feet. (There is no save for this effect.)

This replaces wild shape.

Light Steps (Ex)

At 9th level, a lunar-touched druid learns to move while barely touching the surface underneath her. As a full-round action, she can move up to twice her speed, ignoring difficult terrain. While moving in this way, any surface will support her, no matter how much she weighs. This allows her to move across water, lava, or even the thinnest tree branches. She must end her move on a surface that can support her normally. She cannot move across air in this way, nor can she walk up walls or other vertical surfaces.

When moving in this way, the druid does not take damage from surfaces or hazards that react to being touched, such as lava or caltrops, nor does she need to make Acrobatics checks to avoid falling on slippery or rough surfaces. Finally, when using light steps, the druid ignores any mechanical traps that use a location-based trigger.

This replaces venom immunity.

Gravity Bow (Sp)

At 13th level, as a swift action, a lunar-touched druid gains the effects of gravity bow for a number of rounds per day equal to 1/2 her druid level. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

This replaces a thousand faces.

Blue Moon (Su)

At 20th level, a lunar-touched druid can have two auras active at a time, but she must expend two uses of the lunar aura ability to initiate the second aura, and the duration of the second aura is limited to 1 minute per druid level.
